41309§faulty§adj，有错误的，有缺点的，有故障的§ˈfɔːlti§In addition to faulty brakes, this terrible accident which has caused 3 dead and 1 injured, was attributed to drunk driving.§除了刹车**有问题**之外，酒后驾车也是导致这起三死一伤严重事故的原因。

41331§indifferent§adj冷漠的，不积极的，一般的，（表现的）平平的§ɪnˈdɪfrənt§Tina seems to be totally indifferent to the exam result of the higher language course.§蒂娜似乎对高级语言课程的考试结果毫**不关心**。
41332§inevitable§adj,不可避免的，必然的§ɪnˈevɪtəbl§A further escalation of the economic crisis now seems inevitable.§如今，经济危机的进一步扩大化**在所难免**。
41333§instruct§vt,指示，命令，通知，教授，训练§ɪnˈstrʌkt§PE teachers instruct students how to exercise, play sports, and do other recreational activities correctly and safely.§体育老师**指导**学生们如何安全正确地锻炼、做运动以及进行其他娱乐活动。
41334§interrupt§v,打断，打扰，中断§ˌɪntəˈrʌpt§A: How does your headache affect your daily life? B: It has interrupted my work.§A: 头痛对你的日常生活有什么影响？B: 它**妨碍**到了我工作。

41355§prevail§vi,流行，盛行，战胜，压倒§prɪˈveɪl§The use of horses for ploughing still prevails in this area.§在这一地区用马耕地还很**普遍**。

41357§probable§adj 很可能的，大概的§ˈprɒbəbl§It is probable that, some time in the tenth century, gun powder was first compounded from its basic ingredients of saltpetre, charcoal and sulphur.§火药**很可能**最早在十世纪的某个时间由硝石、木炭和硫磺等基本成分混合而成。

41360§prosperous§adj,繁荣的，兴旺的§ˈprɒspərəs§My grandfather once was a prosperous British businessman.§我祖父曾是一名**成功**的英国商人。

41364§remark§v,说，评论，ｎ 话语，谈论，评论§rɪˈmɑːk§Can you remark the differences between the two paintings?§你能**说出**这两幅画的不同之处吗？
